a configure with UW_BUILD_WORLD=OFF
assessment: Structural. The libraries deliberately declare no link dependencies on each other: world, pipeline and the modules refer to each other in cycles, and a declared dependency of uw_pipeline on uw_world would put the world class on the link line of world_tests and end the planet-free guarantee. The guarantee is now a property of the link: world_tests links five libraries and fails if an object it pulls needs planet. Two libraries stay in geology/mineral_systems because only the frame reader depends on the engine. The old executables in out/build/desktop/bin/Release (climate_pipeline.exe and the former test programs) are leftovers of earlier phases, not built by any target.
lessons: The reference bundles of the next step are out/scratch/phase4/step02-*.
PNG is now found for every configuration, because uw_io always contains the heightmap I/O of the engine tests.

phase: consolidation phase 4, step 3: one include root (src/) and the layering rules in check_layout.py
hypothesis: Every project include can be written as its path from src/, with one include directory for all targets and the layering of section 2 checked, without changing a result.

files: 286 source files under src/ and tests/: 870 quoted includes rewritten to their path from src/ (for example "world/planet.hpp", "simulations/climate/detail/land_ice.hpp", "core/world/world_grid.hpp"), the engine and its tests included; the relative forms ("../", "../../src/") are gone. Left as they are: three test-local helpers, the generated tectonic_baseline.inc, gtest, ImGui and SFML.

CMake: uw_includes is the single directory src/; the include directories of uw_app (rendering), uw_mineral_systems and uw_tectonics are removed (the engine keeps its build directory for the generated baseline)
src/world/classes.* -> src/core (value classes without dependencies; core/grid_coordinates.hpp includes them); classes.cpp no longer includes world/functions.hpp

scripts/check_layout.py: include_issues(): a quoted include is a path from src/ (tests may include a header beside themselves); core includes only core; simulations and pipeline include neither app nor cli; SFML and ImGui only in app; the engine boundary compares paths
AGENTS.md: the include rule and the library-per-directory rule

observed.layering_check: on the tree: passed, after it reported core/classes.cpp including world/functions.hpp (removed). On a planted tree (out/scratch/phase4/layering_fails.py) all eight violations are reported: core including world, pipeline including cli and app, simulations including app, a bare sibling include, a bare project header in a test, imgui outside app, an internal engine header outside the engine.
observed.rewrite: a second pass of the rewrite changes nothing; no include was ambiguous (no two headers under src/ share a name)

assessment: Structural. The rules of section 2 hold and are enforced. Not rules, and still true (out/scratch/phase4/include_graph.py lists them): io includes world (map_imports) and society (social_definitions); validation includes world (generation_tuning) and pipeline (progress, debug); simulations/climate includes pipeline, io and validation; world/functions.hpp includes pipeline and four modules; hydrology and terrain include resources/physical_layers_internal.hpp. Most go when functions.hpp dissolves (step 9) and climate_coupling.cpp and climate_validation.cpp are split (steps 6 and 7).
lessons: A quoted include is searched beside the including file first, so the compiler accepts a bare sibling name; only check_layout.py keeps the include root.
